entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim, three rugged mountain ranges hiding a dwarven city.

entities.name: City of Eight Doors
entities.description: Fabled impregnable dwarven city reachable through eight golden doors.

entities.name: Bloodhammer Hall
entities.description: Largest auditorium of the city, named for founder Vilnus Bloodhammer.

entities.name: Vilnus Bloodhammer
entities.description: Founder of the City of Eight Doors.

entities.name: Gunnar the Breathless
entities.description: Famed skald who declaimed for three days and nights without pausing.

entities.name: Goldmaw Chasm
entities.description: Endless supply of liquid gold beneath the city.

entities.name: Goldeater
entities.description: Cosmos Giant foretold to nearly destroy the City of Eight Doors.

events.summary: Gunnar the Breathless declaimed for three days and nights without taking a breath.
events.quote: The famed Gunnar the Breathless once declaimed for three days and three nights without pausing to take a breath

events.summary: An unfinished saga foretells the Goldeater nearly destroying the city.
events.quote: An unfinished saga foretells the near destruction of the City of Eight Doors by the Goldeater

relations.quote: named in honor of the city's founder, Vilnus Bloodhammer
Axgard is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim
